subject: START statement
notes:
kb/Work PB352. RULE: "The execution of the START statement does not alter either the content of the record area or the content of the data item referenced by the data-name specified in the DEPENDING ON phrase of the RECORD clause…" (cite.py --check 14.9.41.4 "does not alter either the content of the record area" -> OK §14.9.41.4 2)). CODE: EmitStart only READS — `OperandText.AsString(new BoundFieldOperand(sta.Operand!), num)` for the indexed key and `NumericRenderer.Align(num.FieldNum(sta.Operand!),0)` for the relative RRN — then stores the file status and runs the §9.1.14 branch; neither connector's Start/StartFirstLast writes back an image. MEASURED — BOTH HALVES: probe start-p2-g (relative, RECORD IS VARYING IN SIZE FROM 4 TO 8 DEPENDING ON RLEN): after a SUCCESSFUL `START RLF FIRST` -> RLEN=08, REC=[ZZZZZZZZ] unchanged; after an UNSUCCESSFUL `START RLF KEY = RK` ('23') -> RLEN=07, REC=[YYYYYYY ] unchanged. probe start-p2-b (indexed): T1 REC-AREA=[ABZZCCCC] and T6 REC-AREA=[AB02ZZZZ] both survive the START verbatim. WHY NOT CONFORMS: the SEQUENTIAL-organization arm cannot execute at all — START on ORGANIZATION SEQUENTIAL compiles to a BoundUnsupported and throws NotImplementedCobolFeatureException at run time (probe start-p2-h), so GR2 is unhonoured there; GR-14.9.41.4-20/-21 in part 3 own that arm. No spec-derived covering test. || EDITIONS AS ADJUDICATED: 1985 / 2002 / 2014 / 2023 — no edition marker in the clause; Annex E lists no START change.
